messages:
sana: Heads-up — we need a rapid egress-path swap for customer-zenith. Upstream S3 region is flapping and requests are timing out. I'll propose a short-lived route switch (<=5m) to the fallback region while infra finishes the repair. Need oncall + quick rollback plan.

lee: What's the exact match we flip? can we scope to just zenith tenant?

taylor: We can do a route rewrite scoped to header `x-tenant-id: zenith`. Match rule: `route.path == /v1/* && headers.x-tenant-id == "zenith"` and send to `egress-pool-fallback-eu`. Will preserve auth header.

vikram: Also watch token quotas — zenith is on a higher QPS bucket; if fallback has tighter quotas we might hit 429s. Suggest we temporarily bump the per-tenant quota to 2x for the swap window.

sana: Agreed. Plan: 1) Add ephemeral header-scoped route, 2) raise tenant quota for 5m, 3) monitor latency+5xx, 4) revert. Who can run the flip?

lee: I can run the console toggle. Two commands: quick curl to create route and then a console toggle to promote. Example: ```bash
# create match
POST /api/internal/routes -d '{"match":"/v1/*","header":{"x-tenant-id":"zenith"},"backend":"egress-pool-fallback-eu","weight":1}'
```
Then toggle `routes/zenith-fallback` to active.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: route-service: Received request create(routing-entry) id=rt-9f2a. Creating in staging, propagation ETA ~10s.

taylor: For safety, set `max_concurrent` on that rule to 200 and `burst` to 400. Also add header `x-egress-origin: fallback-eu` so we can filter traces.

vikram: I'll bump quota: `PATCH /api/internal/quotas/tenants/zenith -d '{"qps": 2000}'` — will hold for 5m then revert. I'll post the revert timer.

sana: Execute now. Lee to run route create + activate, Vikram to patch quota, Taylor to add header tag, I'll watch traces and run smoke.

lee: Running create... ```json
{"match":"/v1/*","headers":{"x-tenant-id":"zenith"},"backend":"egress-pool-fallback-eu","meta":{"tag":"ephemeral-zenith-swap"}}
```
ops-bot: route-service: Created routing-entry rt-9f2a, propagation done.

lee: Activating route toggle in console -> clicking ENABLE -> toggled. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

vikram: Quota patched. Old qps=1000 -> new qps=2000. Revert scheduled at +5m (1961234867).

taylor: Header injection in place (`x-egress-origin: fallback-eu`). Adding a debug opentelemetry tag: `rt=rt-9f2a`.

sana: Smoke: `curl -H "x-tenant-id: zenith" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/status` -> 200, latency 220ms. Checking traces now.

vikram: Alerting: setup short metric watch — if 5xx rate > 0.5% or lat_p95 > 1s -> rollback.

lee: Seeing traffic shift ~100% for zenith to fallback. No 5xx in the last 20s. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: infra-monitor: Detected increased latency on egress-primary, but fallback pool stable.

taylor: Can we keep the ephemeral route on until infra confirms primary fixed? I want an explicit revert, not auto.

sana: Let's leave it for max 10m. If primary healthy before that, we'll revert early. Vikram — I'll need your thumbs-up before we extend beyond 10m.

vikram: Agreed. Setting timer for 5m auto-revert. Will extend only with SRE approval.

lee: Timer set. Revert command (if needed): ```bash
DELETE /api/internal/routes/rt-9f2a
PATCH /api/internal/quotas/tenants/zenith -d '{"qps":1000}'
```

sana: Good. If we hit a regression, use revert and post `incident:egress-swap` in #incidents.

(50s later)

lee: Noting a small spike in 429s for downstream logging when quota was bumped — digging.

taylor: 429s are from a logging subservice in fallback that didn't scale. I'm rolling a fast patch to its replica count. ```kubectl scale deploy logging --replicas=4 -n fallback```

ops-bot: kube-bot: scaled deployment logging -> 4 replicas.

lee: 429s subsided. All good.

vikram: Primary has recovered (storage error fixed). I'm observing decreased error budget usage. Recommend revert now.

sana: Revert in 30s: Lee, execute delete route + quota revert.

lee: Executing revert... ```bash
DELETE /api/internal/routes/rt-9f2a || true
PATCH /api/internal/quotas/tenants/zenith -d '{"qps":1000}'
```
ops-bot: route-service: Deleted rt-9f2a.

lee: Done. Smoke check: `curl -H "x-tenant-id: zenith" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/status` -> 200 via primary, latency 180ms.

sana: Nice work team. Postmortem: add note under #incidents about ephemeral header-scoped routing as an approved emergency pattern and add a checklist for logging/quotas next time.

vikram: I'll create a short runbook entry and link it to the incident.

(tail)

ops-bot: incident-bot: Created incident egress-swap-1961234567, severity=3, assignees=[vikram,sana].
